title.zh: 目前的证据能支持什么

intro.en: Reviewed on November 28, 2026. Read each result with its sample and open question. An implemented method is not a verified execution outcome.
intro.zh: 核查日期为2026年11月28日。每项结果都列出样本范围与未解决问题，方法已经实现也不代表实际成交已经验证。

finding.en: The frozen NAV supports a dated return path and drawdown calculations.
finding.zh: 冻结净值可以复现收益路径及回撤日期。

scope.en: Published 400-stock rule reconstruction; not an official index.
scope.zh: 已发布的400只规则重建，不是官方指数。

open.en: A holdings and cash ledger tied to this exact NAV.
open.zh: 与这条净值同源的持仓和现金账户。

finding.en: A separately pinned reconstruction retains security-level marks, linked contributions and a fixed-cohort cash exit scenario.
finding.zh: 独立固定的重建已保留逐证券估值、连接式贡献和固定持仓现金退出情景。

scope.en: Daily selection and marking; historical labels may contain revisions.
scope.zh: 日频选股与估值，历史标签可能包含修订。

open.en: Historical eligibility, corporate-action cash flows and actual execution.
open.zh: 历史资格、公司行动现金流和实际执行。

finding.en: Quote replay reports modeled quantity, remainder and price shortfall together.
finding.zh: 报价回放已同时记录模拟数量、余量与价格损失。

scope.en: Selected short windows and additional dates; not a certified equity universe.
scope.zh: 选定的短窗口和新增日期，尚非认证股票池。

open.en: Accessible liquidity, routing, queue priority and own impact.
open.zh: 可访问流动性、路由、排队与自身冲击。

finding.en: Full-day and wider-window checks help distinguish sparse short windows from missing days.
finding.zh: 全天与较宽窗口检查，有助于区分短时无记录和整天缺失。

scope.en: Reference-matched pilot dates, with UTC/local time comparison.
scope.zh: 参考映射后的试验日期，已比较 UTC 与本地时间。

open.en: Independent feed completeness and historical common-stock eligibility.
open.zh: 独立数据源完整性与历史普通股资格。

finding.en: Explicit fee assumptions can be added to modeled fills; membership replacement is a separate diagnostic.
finding.zh: 可以对模拟数量计算显性费用，目标成员替换另作诊断。

scope.en: Per-share, parent minimum and notional fee scenarios.
scope.zh: 每股、母订单最低费用与按金额计费情景。

open.en: Actual fee schedules, portfolio drift and unfilled orders.
open.zh: 实际费率、持仓漂移与未成交订单。

finding.en: Compare definitions and constraints before ranking returns.
finding.zh: 先对齐定义与约束，再比较收益。

scope.en: China A-share daily data and US NBBO/trades answer different questions.
scope.zh: 中国 A 股日线与美股报价、成交数据各有适用范围。

open.en: Comparable historical universes, calendars, currency and execution rules.
open.zh: 可比的历史股票池、日历、币种和执行规则。
